components.label: Spire Legacy with content reader and modding libraries

notes.beforeInstall: Requires your owned Windows Steam copies of Slay the Spire 1 on its regular branch and Rogue Legacy 2. The mod finds Rogue Legacy 2 in your Steam libraries and reads its content locally; no game assets are included.
notes.firstLaunch: Choose The Heir in Slay the Spire. Your first family run enters combat immediately; after it ends, select The Heir again and use Family Manor beneath the character description to choose heirs and buy upgrades.
